rewrites.yea_description: Voted for House Bill 1130, which let a school district pay its property insurance premiums from its capital outlay fund. The South Dakota House vote was 41-25. The Governor signed it on March 04, 2026.
rewrites.nay_description: Voted against House Bill 1130, which let a school district pay its property insurance premiums from its capital outlay fund. The South Dakota House vote was 41-25. The Governor signed it on March 04, 2026.

rewrites.yea_description: Voted for House Bill 1066, which broadened when a contractor who misuses a customer's money commits theft. The South Dakota House vote was 46-19. The Governor signed it on March 30, 2026.
rewrites.nay_description: Voted against House Bill 1066, which broadened when a contractor who misuses a customer's money commits theft. The South Dakota House vote was 46-19. The Governor signed it on March 30, 2026.

rewrites.yea_description: Voted for House Bill 1062, which extended aggravated assault to threats made with a realistic fake weapon. The South Dakota House vote was 44-22. The Governor signed it on March 09, 2026.
rewrites.nay_description: Voted against House Bill 1062, which extended aggravated assault to threats made with a realistic fake weapon. The South Dakota House vote was 44-22. The Governor signed it on March 09, 2026.

rewrites.yea_description: Voted for Senate Bill 198, a bill to make a company try mediation before condemning private land. The South Dakota Senate passed it, 18-17. A South Dakota House committee killed it, so the full House never voted on it and the bill did not become law.
rewrites.nay_description: Voted against Senate Bill 198, a bill to make a company try mediation before condemning private land. The South Dakota Senate passed it, 18-17. A South Dakota House committee killed it, so the full House never voted on it and the bill did not become law.

rewrites.yea_description: Voted for Senate Bill 196, a bill to widen the property tax assessment freeze for lower-income homeowners. The South Dakota Senate rejected it, 15-18. The bill did not become law.
rewrites.nay_description: Voted against Senate Bill 196, a bill to widen the property tax assessment freeze for lower-income homeowners. The South Dakota Senate rejected it, 15-18. The bill did not become law.
